sentences.text: Es domingo y la familia de Karla se levanta temprano.
sentences.english: It is Sunday and Karla's family gets up early.

sentences.text: Hoy van a la iglesia.
sentences.english: Today they go to church.

sentences.text: Van Karla, su madre doña Reina, su padre don José y su hermano menor, Kevin.
sentences.english: Karla, her mother doña Reina, her father don José and her younger brother Kevin all go.

sentences.text: Se ponen su mejor ropa y salen de la casa.
sentences.english: They put on their best clothes and leave the house.

sentences.text: La iglesia no está lejos, y caminan veinte minutos.
sentences.english: The church is not far, and they walk for twenty minutes.

sentences.text: Frente a la puerta, don Mario saluda a todos.
sentences.english: In front of the door, don Mario greets everyone.

sentences.text: —Buenos días, doña Reina —dice don Mario.
sentences.english: "Good morning, doña Reina," says don Mario.

sentences.text: —Buenos días, don Mario, ¿cómo está usted? —pregunta doña Reina.
sentences.english: "Good morning, don Mario, how are you?" asks doña Reina.

sentences.text: —Estoy bien, gracias a Dios —responde don Mario.
sentences.english: "I am well, thank God," answers don Mario.

sentences.text: Adentro, la iglesia está llena de gente.
sentences.english: Inside, the church is full of people.

sentences.text: Los niños se sientan con sus padres.
sentences.english: The children sit with their parents.

sentences.text: Un grupo de jóvenes toca la guitarra y todos cantan.
sentences.english: A group of young people plays the guitar and everyone sings.

sentences.text: Después un hombre lee un pasaje de la Biblia.
sentences.english: Then a man reads a passage from the Bible.

sentences.text: El pastor habla del amor de Dios y de cómo ayudar a los vecinos.
sentences.english: The pastor speaks about God's love and about how to help our neighbors.

sentences.text: Kevin no quiere estar sentado, pero escucha.
sentences.english: Kevin does not want to sit still, but he listens.

sentences.text: Al final todos oran.
sentences.english: At the end everyone prays.

sentences.text: Después del servicio, la gente se queda afuera.
sentences.english: After the service, the people stay outside.

sentences.text: Los hombres hablan, las mujeres hablan y los niños corren.
sentences.english: The men talk, the women talk and the children run.

sentences.text: Una señora le ofrece café a doña Reina.
sentences.english: A woman offers doña Reina some coffee.

sentences.text: —Muchas gracias —dice doña Reina.
sentences.english: "Thank you very much," says doña Reina.

sentences.text: —Con mucho gusto —responde la señora.
sentences.english: "My pleasure," answers the woman.

sentences.text: Karla habla con una amiga, y Kevin juega con otros cipotes.
sentences.english: Karla talks with a friend, and Kevin plays with other cipotes.

sentences.text: A mediodía, la familia vuelve a casa.
sentences.english: At noon, the family goes back home.

sentences.text: Hoy van a comer juntos, como todos los domingos.
sentences.english: Today they are going to eat together, as every Sunday.
